title: Set prompt label
description: Point a label (for example 'production') at a specific version of an LLM prompt. A label is a movable pointer to exactly one version: if the label already exists on another version of this prompt, it is moved there. Use labels to mark a version as released ('production', 'staging') or roll back by pointing the label at an earlier version. Label names use lowercase letters, numbers, dots, hyphens and underscores; 'latest' is reserved and numbers-only names are not allowed. Each prompt can have at most 50 labels.
